user.title: Connect ATHLTH
user.description: Add the ATHLTH bridge to Home Assistant. Pairing with the ATHLTH app is completed securely from the app and does not require you to create or paste an API key.

init.title: Pair ATHLTH locally
init.description:
Open ATHLTH on your iPhone and choose Home Assistant. Select this Home Assistant instance, then enter **{pairing_code}**.

Local address: `{address}`

The code expires in {expires_minutes} minutes and can be used once. OAuth remains available as a fallback from the ATHLTH app.

abort.not_loaded: ATHLTH is not loaded yet. Reload the integration and try again.
